senses.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
ex.zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

ex.en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
ex.zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。

col: from nine a.m.｜从上午九点起
until eleven a.m.｜直到上午十一点
tip: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
ex.zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something
skilled and effective at doing things

ex.en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
ex.zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。

ex.en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。

col: an able leader｜能干的领导者
an able student｜有才干的学生
tip: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

senses.en: concerning a particular subject
approximately, rather than exactly
in various places within or around somewhere

ex.en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

ex.en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
ex.zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。

tip: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

senses.en: Not present where someone is expected to be.
Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.

ex.en: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
ex.zh: 莉娜因身体不适没有来上课。

ex.en: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。

tip: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

senses.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: As stated or reported by someone or something
In a way determined by a rule or particular factor

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
ex.zh: 据天气预报，今晚会下雨。

ex.en: Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.
ex.zh: 公共资金应按当地需求分配，而不应取决于各地区的政治影响力。

tip: 通常用according to，不单独作形容词。

senses.en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service
a spoken or written description of events
with for: explain something or constitute a share of something

ex.en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
ex.zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。

ex.en: Transport costs account for a substantial share of household spending, particularly in areas with limited public services.
ex.zh: 交通费用占家庭支出的很大一部分，在公共服务有限的地区尤其如此。

tip: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

senses.en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp
a steady pain that lasts for some time
to want something very deeply

ex.en: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
ex.zh: 爬完那么多级楼梯后，我的双腿酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
ex.zh: 经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。

tip: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
ex.zh: 通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill.
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Finishing my first long hike felt like a real achievement.
ex.zh: 完成第一次长途徒步让我觉得很有成就感。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。

ex.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.
Something that someone does.
A law formally approved by a legislative body.

ex.en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
ex.zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。

ex.en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。

tip: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.
The state of being busy or doing things.

ex.en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。

tip: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

senses.en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television
A person or organisation involved in a particular situation

ex.en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
ex.zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。

ex.en: Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
ex.zh: 专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。

tip: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

senses.en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films

ex.en: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
ex.zh: 那位女演员向剧院外的人群挥手。

ex.en: A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
ex.zh: 一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。

tip: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

senses.en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected

ex.en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
ex.zh: 我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。

tip: actually表示“其实”，不表示“目前”。

senses.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount
to combine numbers to find their total
to say something more after an earlier statement

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex.zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

ex.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

tip: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

senses.en: the act of putting something extra into something
the process of finding the total of quantities
something extra that joins an existing group or collection

ex.en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
ex.zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。

ex.en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。

col: a welcome addition｜受欢迎的新事物
tip: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.
To give attention to a problem and try to solve it.
To speak directly to a person or group.

ex.en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
ex.zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。

ex.en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
ex.zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

tip: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
ex.zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.
Fully grown, or relating to grown people.

ex.en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
ex.zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。

ex.en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。

tip: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

senses.en: Something that makes success more likely than for others.
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
ex.zh: 你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger
Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations

ex.en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
ex.zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。

ex.en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。

col: a sense of adventure｜冒险精神
tip: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

ex.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
ex.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: Tell someone what you think they should do
Officially give someone information about something

ex.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
ex.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

ex.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

col: advise someone to do something｜建议某人做某事
tip: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

senses.en: to cause a change in someone or something
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
ex.zh: 喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: to have enough money or resources for something
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford a new sofa this month.
ex.zh: 我们这个月买不起新沙发。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: feeling fear or worry about something
used to introduce unwelcome information politely

ex.en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。

ex.en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。

col: afraid of making mistakes｜害怕犯错
tip: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

senses.en: The continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic and Indian oceans.

ex.en: My cousin returned from Africa with beautiful handmade baskets.
ex.zh: 我的表亲从非洲回来，带回了漂亮的手工编织篮子。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy across Africa could expand electricity access while supporting sustainable economic development.
ex.zh: 在非洲各地投资可再生能源可以扩大电力覆盖范围，同时支持经济的可持续发展。

tip: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加冠词；非洲不是国家。

senses.en: relating to Africa or its people
a person from Africa

ex.en: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
ex.zh: 我们在一个泥泞的水塘边发现了几头非洲象。

ex.en: Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 许多非洲国家正投资太阳能，以改善偏远农村社区的电力供应。

tip: 首字母须大写；表示来自非洲，不限定肤色。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

senses.en: The time between midday and evening.

ex.en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。

ex.en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
ex.zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。

tip: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。

senses.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.
Touching or supported by a surface.
For protection from something harmful or unwanted.

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。

ex.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

tip: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
ex.zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
ex.zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。

col: a long time ago｜很久以前
as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

senses.en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
ex.zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward.
Further advanced than others or earlier than expected.
In the future, or in preparation for it.

ex.en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
ex.zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。

ex.en: Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
ex.zh: 城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。

col: ahead of schedule｜比预定时间提前
ahead of the competition｜领先竞争对手
tip: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。

senses.en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support.
To help someone or make a process easier.
An object or device that helps someone do something.

ex.en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
ex.zh: 志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。

ex.en: International aid can improve access to clean water, but lasting progress also requires investment in local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 国际援助可以改善清洁用水的获取条件，但持久进步还需要对当地基础设施进行投资。

tip: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

senses.en: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth that people breathe.
A particular quality that someone or something seems to have.
To let fresh air in, or express views publicly.

ex.en: I opened the window to let fresh air in.
ex.zh: 我打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Improving air quality in cities requires cleaner transport and stricter controls on industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 改善城市空气质量需要更清洁的交通方式，以及对工业排放更严格的管控。

col: an air of confidence｜自信的神态
tip: 表示空气时不可数；an air of表示“带有某种气质”。

senses.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

ex.en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。

ex.en: Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
ex.zh: 扩建机场可能促进旅游业，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪声污染。

tip: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。

senses.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs
an established route used by aircraft

ex.en: The nurse checked that the patient's airway was clear.
ex.zh: 护士检查了病人的气道是否通畅。

ex.en: Heavy traffic along a major airway requires careful coordination to keep aircraft safely separated.
ex.zh: 主要航路上的繁忙交通需要精心协调，以确保飞机保持安全间距。

col: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅
tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

senses.en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you.
A sudden feeling of fear or worry.
To make someone frightened or worried.

ex.en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。

ex.en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。

tip: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

senses.en: Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts
A living creature believed or imagined to come from another planet
Coming from a different country or natural environment

ex.en: The city's constant noise felt alien after our quiet village.
ex.zh: 住惯了安静的村庄后，城市持续不断的噪声让我们感到很陌生。

ex.en: Teaching methods that seem alien to international students may require careful explanation and additional support from university staff.
ex.zh: 对于国际学生感到陌生的教学方法，大学教职员工可能需要仔细解释并提供额外支持。

tip: 称外国人为alien有疏离感；通常用foreign national。

senses.en: similar in appearance or character
in the same way, or equally for both groups

ex.en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。

ex.en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。

tip: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。

tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

senses.en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group
everything or everyone in a particular group
completely or entirely

ex.en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
ex.zh: 所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民无论收入如何，都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。

tip: all可接复数或不可数名词；every接单数可数名词。

senses.en: Having an allergy to a particular substance
Caused by an allergy

ex.en: I am allergic to cats, so I keep my distance.
ex.zh: 我对猫过敏，所以会和猫保持距离。

ex.en: Restaurants should provide accurate ingredient information to protect customers who are allergic to common foods.
ex.zh: 餐馆应提供准确的配料信息，以保护对常见食物过敏的顾客。

tip: 说对某物过敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
ex.zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

ex.en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。

tip: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

col: bring someone along｜带某人一起来
tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: With an audible voice rather than silently.

ex.en: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
ex.zh: 我搅拌的时候，请把食谱读出来。

ex.en: Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.
ex.zh: 大声朗读故事可以帮助幼儿积累词汇，并增强他们对口语的理解。

tip: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

col: already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex.zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。

col: not only ... but also｜不仅……而且
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

col: although it is true that｜虽然确实……
although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: to surprise someone very much

ex.en: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
ex.zh: 魔术师巧妙的戏法总能让孩子们惊叹不已。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。

col: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹
tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
ex.zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal.
Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.

ex.en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
ex.zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。

ex.en: Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。

col: ambition to succeed｜追求成功的雄心
tip: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

senses.en: the United States of America
North and South America considered together

ex.en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到美国去学工程。

ex.en: Many universities in America attract international students through their research facilities and diverse academic programmes.
ex.zh: 美国的许多大学凭借研究设施和多样化的学术课程吸引国际学生。

tip: 日常多指美国；南北美洲合称常用the Americas。

senses.en: relating to the United States, its people, or its culture
a person from the United States

ex.en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
ex.zh: 我的美国邻居邀请我们去他家吃南瓜派。

ex.en: American universities attract international students through their diverse courses, research facilities, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 美国大学凭借多样的课程、科研设施和职业发展机会吸引国际学生。

tip: 首字母始终大写；通常指美国，而非整个美洲。

senses.en: surrounded by people or things
within or shared by a group

ex.en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
ex.zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。

ex.en: Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。

col: among other things｜除了别的以外还
tip: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

senses.en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。

ex.en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
ex.zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。

tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

senses.en: a strong feeling of displeasure about something wrong or unfair
to make someone feel angry

ex.en: He took a deep breath to control his anger.
ex.zh: 他深吸了一口气来控制自己的怒气。

ex.en: Public anger over rising transport costs can encourage local authorities to reconsider their pricing policies.
ex.zh: 公众对交通费用上涨的愤怒，可能促使地方政府重新考虑定价政策。

tip: anger作名词通常不可数；形容词是angry。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

senses.en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures
relating to animals rather than plants

ex.en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
ex.zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。

ex.en: Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
ex.zh: 保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。

tip: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

senses.en: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

senses.en: a reply, correct result, or solution to a problem
to reply to someone or respond to a call

ex.en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
ex.zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。

ex.en: Improving public transport may provide an answer to traffic congestion in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通或许能为快速发展的城市地区提供缓解交通拥堵的办法。

col: the answer to a problem｜问题的解决办法
tip: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

senses.en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.

ex.en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。

ex.en: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
ex.zh: 蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。

tip: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

senses.en: the ice-covered continent surrounding the South Pole

ex.en: My cousin photographed penguins during a trip to Antarctica.
ex.zh: 我表亲去南极洲旅行时拍了企鹅的照片。

ex.en: Scientists studying Antarctica analyse ancient ice to understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究南极洲的科学家通过分析古老冰层，了解地球气候如何随时间变化。

col: the coast of Antarctica｜南极洲海岸
tip: 洲名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex.zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。

col: any of these｜这些中的任何一个
tip: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex.en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
ex.zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？

ex.en: Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。

tip: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.
Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
ex.zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。

ex.en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。

col: do it anyway｜无论如何还是去做
thanks anyway｜不管怎样还是谢谢你
tip: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

senses.zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方
senses.en: in or to any place
in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

senses.en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.

ex.en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。

ex.en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
ex.zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。

tip: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

senses.en: To tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong

ex.en: I apologized to my neighbour for the noise.
ex.zh: 我为噪声向邻居道了歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
ex.zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。

col: apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉
tip: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

senses.en: A computer program designed for a particular task.

ex.en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
ex.zh: 这个应用程序每周日提醒我给植物浇水。

ex.en: A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.
ex.zh: 语言学习应用可以提供价格低廉的练习机会，但无法完全取代与教师的互动。

col: download an app｜下载应用程序
install an app｜安装应用程序
language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

senses.en: To become visible or come into view.
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: the way someone or something looks
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
ex.zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin

ex.en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。

ex.en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: A particular part of a place or geographical region
The amount of surface that something covers
A particular subject or part of an activity

ex.en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
ex.zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。

col: an area of research｜研究领域
tip: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

senses.en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way.
To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.

ex.en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
ex.zh: 孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。

ex.en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。

tip: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

senses.en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand.
A projecting part of an object, especially a chair.
To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

ex.en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。

col: arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

senses.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.
A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.

ex.en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
ex.zh: 我的表亲毕业后参军了。

ex.en: During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.
ex.zh: 发生严重洪灾时，如果民用服务不堪重负，军队可以提供必要的运输服务和物资。

col: serve in the army｜在陆军服役
an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

senses.en: On different sides of something or surrounding it.
Approximately, rather than exactly.
In or to various places within an area.

ex.en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

ex.en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

senses.en: The act of reaching a place.
A person or thing that has recently reached a place.

ex.en: Our arrival at the campsite was delayed by heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨耽误了我们抵达营地的时间。

ex.en: The arrival of faster rail services has made smaller towns more attractive to commuters seeking affordable housing.
ex.zh: 更快捷的铁路服务使小城镇对寻求可负担住房的通勤者更有吸引力。

col: arrival at the airport｜抵达机场
tip: on arrival意为一到达，相当于upon arrival。

senses.en: To reach the place you were travelling to.
For an event or a particular time to come.

ex.en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我们的客人恰好在晚饭准备好时到了。

ex.en: Reliable public transport helps employees arrive at work on time and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通有助于员工准时上班，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: arrive at the station｜到达车站
arrive in a city｜抵达城市
arrive at a conclusion｜得出结论
tip: 小地点用 at，城市国家用 in；home 前不加介词。

senses.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing
objects or images created to express ideas or beauty
a skill developed through practice and careful understanding

ex.en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

ex.en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。

col: a work of art｜一件艺术作品
the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

ex.en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。

col: an article of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art
a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally

ex.en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
ex.zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。

ex.en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
ex.zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。

tip: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。

senses.en: used to indicate someone's role or something's purpose
introduces a time, reason, or way something happens
used in comparisons to show an equal degree

ex.en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
ex.zh: 她在当地博物馆担任讲解员。

ex.en: As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.
ex.zh: 随着公共交通变得更加可靠，选择开车上班的通勤者可能会减少。

tip: as表示实际身份；like表示相似。重读时读/æz/。

senses.en: Relating to Asia or its people.
A person from Asia or with family origins there.

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。

ex.en: Many Asian cities are expanding public transport networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 许多亚洲城市正扩建公共交通网络，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 首字母须大写；Asia是洲名，Asian可作形容词。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

senses.en: a person trained to travel and work in space

ex.en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
ex.zh: 那名宇航员轻轻地飘过小型空间站。

ex.en: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
ex.zh: 宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。

col: a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员
tip: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

ex.en: Meet me at the school gate.
ex.zh: 在学校门口和我会合。

ex.en: The lesson starts at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 这节课九点开始。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

ex.en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
ex.zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。

ex.en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
ex.zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。

col: a promising young athlete｜有潜力的年轻运动员
tip: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。

senses.en: The ocean between the Americas and Europe and Africa.
Relating to the Atlantic Ocean or its surrounding regions.

ex.en: We watched huge waves roll in from the Atlantic.
ex.zh: 我们看着巨浪从大西洋翻涌而来。

ex.en: Changes in Atlantic ocean currents could influence weather patterns and agricultural production across several continents.
ex.zh: 大西洋洋流的变化可能影响多个大洲的天气模式和农业生产。

tip: 首字母大写；作名词通常用the Atlantic。

senses.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly
An act of violence or strong criticism
A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms

ex.en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
ex.zh: 我走近池塘时，那只鹅突然啄起我的包。

ex.en: Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.
ex.zh: 批评者猛烈抨击这项提案，因为它几乎没有为贫困家庭提供支持。

col: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击
attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

senses.en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution
to deal with something or care for someone

ex.en: My sister attends a dance class every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六上午都去上舞蹈课。

ex.en: Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.
ex.zh: 经常听课的学生更有可能理解难懂的概念并顺利完成作业。

col: attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.
Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。

ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

senses.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: A place or feature that people want to visit or experience.
The power to interest someone or draw them towards something.

ex.en: The old castle is the town's most popular attraction.
ex.zh: 那座古堡是镇上最受欢迎的景点。

ex.en: Although tourism creates jobs, overcrowding at major attractions can damage historic buildings and disrupt local life.
ex.zh: 虽然旅游业创造就业机会，但主要景点过度拥挤可能损坏历史建筑，扰乱当地生活。

tip: 指景点时可数；指吸引力时通常不可数。

senses.en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
ex.zh: 舞者表演结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
ex.zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。

ex.en: Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.
ex.zh: 姑姨叔舅等大家庭成员常为在职父母提供宝贵的育儿支持。

col: aunt and uncle｜姑姨叔舅等亲属
tip: 不区分父系或母系；美音也常读/ɑːnt/。

senses.en: a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans

ex.en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到澳大利亚学习海洋生物学。

ex.en: Australia attracts international students through its universities, diverse cities, and opportunities to study in English.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚凭借其大学、多元化城市以及英语授课的学习机会吸引国际学生。

col: travel to Australia｜去澳大利亚旅行
study in Australia｜在澳大利亚留学
tip: Australia指澳大利亚；Austria才是奥地利。

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

senses.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
ex.zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex.en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。

ex.en: Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.
ex.zh: 熬夜不睡的学生第二天上午上课时可能难以集中注意力。

tip: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex.en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
ex.zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。

ex.en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
ex.zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。

tip: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

senses.en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。

tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

senses.en: a very young child or animal
very young, or intended for babies
treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care

ex.en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
ex.zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。

ex.en: Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务有助于婴儿的父母重返工作岗位，而不会给家庭财务带来过大压力。

tip: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

senses.en: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex.en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
ex.zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。

ex.en: Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 当地居民很可能支持能缓解拥堵并方便就业出行的交通项目。

col: at the back of｜在…的后部
tip: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

senses.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable
To a serious or harmful degree
Very much, especially when wanting or needing something

ex.en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
ex.zh: 房间太热，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会限制人们前往学校、医院和市场，严重影响农村社区。

tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。

senses.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。

ex.en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。

tip: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.

ex.en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
ex.zh: 孩子们摆餐具时，我烤了些面包。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
ex.zh: 学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。

tip: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。

senses.en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things
To keep something steady or give competing needs suitable attention
The money remaining in an account or still owed

ex.en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
ex.zh: 她下公交车时失去了平衡。

ex.en: Governments must balance the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必须兼顾人们对可负担住房的需求和保护绿地的需要。

col: work-life balance｜工作与生活的平衡
tip: 兼顾两者用balance A with B；均衡饮食用balanced。

senses.en: A raised outdoor platform attached to a building, with a railing.
An upper level of seats in a theatre.

ex.en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台上的小盆里种香草。

ex.en: Apartments with a balcony offer residents valuable outdoor space, particularly in cities where public gardens are scarce.
ex.zh: 带阳台的公寓为住户提供了宝贵的户外空间，在公共花园稀少的城市尤其如此。

tip: 在阳台上用on the balcony，不用in。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。

ex.en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。

tip: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

senses.en: A tall plant with hollow woody stems, or its strong material.

ex.en: She planted bamboo along the fence for extra privacy.
ex.zh: 她沿着围栏种了竹子，让院子更私密。

ex.en: Bamboo grows rapidly and can provide a renewable building material when plantations are managed responsibly.
ex.zh: 竹子生长迅速，在种植园得到负责任管理的情况下，可以提供可再生建筑材料。

tip: 泛指竹子或竹材时通常不可数。

senses.en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin

ex.en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
ex.zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。

ex.en: Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.
ex.zh: 香蕉种植为热带地区的许多家庭提供了重要收入来源。

col: a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip: 可数名词：一根香蕉是a banana。

senses.en: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

ex.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

ex.en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。

tip: IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex.zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

ex.en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。

tip: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

senses.en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog
a short, loud sound made by a dog
the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch

ex.en: Our dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
ex.zh: 每当有人敲门，我们的狗就会叫。

ex.en: The bark of mature trees provides shelter for insects and helps protect the trunk from damage.
ex.zh: 成年树木的树皮为昆虫提供庇护，也有助于保护树干免受损伤。

col: a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫
tip: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

senses.en: The lowest supporting part or underlying foundation of something.
A place from which people work or organise activities.
To use something as the foundation for a decision or idea.

ex.en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
ex.zh: 沉重的底座让灯不易倒下。

ex.en: Governments should base their environmental policies on reliable scientific evidence rather than short-term political interests.
ex.zh: 政府应以可靠的科学证据而非短期政治利益为依据制定环境政策。

tip: base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。

ex.en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
ex.zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。

tip: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials
The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it

ex.en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。

ex.en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
ex.zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。

col: a basket of fruit｜一篮水果
tip: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

ex.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
ex.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

tip: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

ex.en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
ex.zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用较短时间的淋浴代替每天泡澡，可以显著减少家庭用水量。

tip: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

senses.en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet.
A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.

ex.en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
ex.zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。

ex.en: Installing water-saving fixtures in the bathroom can help households reduce consumption without changing their daily routines.
ex.zh: 在浴室安装节水设备，可以帮助家庭在不改变日常习惯的情况下减少用水。

tip: 美式英语中bathroom也可指没有浴缸的厕所。

ex.en: Be kind to your classmates.
ex.zh: 友善地对待你的同学。

ex.en: She was happy to see her old friend.
ex.zh: 她见到老朋友很高兴。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex.en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。

tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

senses.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

ex.en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。

ex.en: Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.
ex.zh: 豆类是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，有助于形成均衡的植物性饮食。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest.
To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm.
A regular pulse of sound or movement.

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。

ex.en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
ex.zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。

tip: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

senses.en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

ex.en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
ex.zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。

col: because of the weather｜由于天气原因
tip: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex.zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

ex.en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。

col: become increasingly important｜变得日益重要
tip: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。

ex.en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
ex.zh: 共用卧室的孩子可能会培养合作能力，但随着成长，他们也需要足够的隐私。

tip: 可数名词；a two-bedroom flat指两居室公寓。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

ex.en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
ex.zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
tip: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex.en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
ex.zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。

ex.en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
ex.zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。

tip: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex.zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

ex.en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。

col: before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

senses.en: to act in a particular way
to act politely and do what is expected
to work or react in a particular way

ex.en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
ex.zh: 有客人来家里时，我们的狗表现得很平静。

ex.en: Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.
ex.zh: 孩子往往通过观察身边的成年人，学习在社交场合如何举止得当。

tip: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。

tip: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

ex.en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
ex.zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。

tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
ex.zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。

ex.en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。

col: belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆
feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something.
In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex.zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

ex.en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
ex.zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。

tip: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes
a long area with a particular feature
a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects

ex.en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
ex.zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。

ex.en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
ex.zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。

tip: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

senses.en: a helpful or positive effect of something
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: One benefit of cycling is arriving home feeling refreshed.
ex.zh: 骑车的一个好处是到家时感觉神清气爽。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: In addition to someone or something.
Used to add another fact or supporting reason.

ex.en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
ex.zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。

ex.en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。

col: besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。

col: at its best｜处于最佳状态
tip: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

senses.en: on the farther side of something
outside a particular limit, range, or ability
at or towards a place farther away

ex.en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。

ex.en: The benefits of university education extend beyond employment prospects to include personal growth and greater social awareness.
ex.zh: 大学教育的益处不仅限于就业前景，还包括个人成长和更强的社会意识。

tip: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

senses.en: one thousand million
an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
ex.zh: 科学博物馆展出了一块有十亿年历史的岩石。

ex.en: Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.
ex.zh: 各国政府投入数十亿美元建设交通基础设施，以促进经济增长并连接偏远社区。

tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

senses.en: A scientist who studies living things.

ex.en: The biologist carefully examined a frog beside the pond.
ex.zh: 那位生物学家在池塘边仔细观察一只青蛙。

ex.en: A marine biologist can help coastal communities understand how pollution affects local fish populations.
ex.zh: 海洋生物学家可以帮助沿海社区了解污染如何影响当地鱼类种群。

tip: 研究海洋生物的专家称为marine biologist。

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
ex.zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。

ex.en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

senses.en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs

ex.en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。

ex.en: Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.
ex.zh: 保护本土鸟类需要维护其栖息地，并减少乡村和城市地区的污染。

tip: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
ex.zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。

ex.en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
ex.zh: 分娩时获得专业医疗护理能显著改善母亲和新生儿的健康状况。

col: the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

ex.en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts
An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food

ex.en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
ex.zh: 她咬了一口苹果，被甜得笑了起来。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should explain how travellers can prevent mosquito bites in regions with tropical diseases.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，旅行者在热带疾病流行地区如何预防蚊虫叮咬。

tip: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。

senses.en: having the darkest colour, like coal
the darkest colour
relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa

ex.en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
ex.zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。

ex.en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。

tip: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
ex.zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。

ex.en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
ex.zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

senses.en: Unable to see.
Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems.
A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.

ex.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
ex.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。

ex.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。

col: blind to the risks｜无视风险
tip: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
ex.zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。

ex.en: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。

col: a block of flats｜一栋公寓楼
a block of ice｜一大块冰
tip: a block of flats指公寓楼，是英式常用表达。

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body
family relationships or origins

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

tip: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

senses.en: A shirt traditionally worn by women, often made from light fabric

ex.en: She wore a blue blouse with her favourite grey trousers.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件蓝色女式衬衫，搭配最喜欢的灰色长裤。

ex.en: Choosing a durable blouse rather than a cheaply made alternative may reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择耐穿的女式衬衫而非制作廉价的替代品，长期来看可能减少衣物浪费。

tip: 通常指女式衬衫；shirt的适用范围更广。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex.zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

ex.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
ex.zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky
the colour of a clear daytime sky
feeling sad or unhappy

ex.en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。

ex.en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。

tip: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex.zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

ex.en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
ex.zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。

tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

senses.en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship

ex.en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。

ex.en: In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.
ex.zh: 在偏远的沿海社区，乘船出行仍是获得教育和医疗服务的重要方式。

tip: by boat不加冠词；on a boat表示在船上。

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。

ex.en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
ex.zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。

tip: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

ex.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。

ex.en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
ex.zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。

col: a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

senses.en: to increase or improve something
something that helps increase or improve something else

ex.en: A short walk can boost your energy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后散一小会儿步能让你更有精神。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can boost local employment and improve access to essential services.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通能促进当地就业，并让人们更容易获得基本服务。

col: give something a boost｜推动某事
tip: 作及物动词，直接接销量、信心等宾语。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

ex.en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
ex.zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。

col: find something boring｜觉得某事无聊
tip: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
ex.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一个下雪的早晨。

ex.en: Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.
ex.zh: 与城市儿童相比，出生在农村的儿童获得专科医疗服务可能更加困难。

col: be born into a family｜出生在某个家庭
a born leader｜天生的领导者
tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？

ex.en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
ex.zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。

tip: borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。
